sentences.en: Fadil always used his heartless scare tactics to control Dania.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔总是用无情的恐吓手段来控制达尼亚。

sentences.en: Sami was killed in a cold and heartless way.
sentences.zh: 萨米是被冷酷无情的方式杀死的。

sentences.en: It is heartless of him to say so.
sentences.zh: 他这么说真是太无情了。

senses.zh: 无情的，狠心的,无情无义,没良心,薄情无义
